items.question: How far in advance should we book our wedding photographer?
items.answer: Prime summer weekends are booked 12–18 months ahead, so we recommend securing your date as soon as your venue is confirmed.

items.question: Do you cover both ceremony and reception?
items.answer: Yes, our full-day collections include preparations, ceremony, portraits and the evening celebration.

items.question: How many edited photos do we receive?
items.answer: A full wedding story includes 600–900 curated images, delivered in both high-resolution and web-ready formats.

items.question: Are engagement sessions included?
items.answer: Every signature package features an engagement session to build trust and create beautiful save-the-date visuals.

items.question: Do you travel for destination weddings?
items.answer: Absolutely. We frequently photograph weddings in Slovenia, Croatia, Italy and the Austrian Alps.

items.question: Can we customize a package?
items.answer: Our proposals are modular—add rehearsal dinner coverage, drone imagery or next-day sessions as needed.

items.question: What happens if the weather changes?
items.answer: We prepare alternative locations, carry weather-proof gear and embrace cinematic rainy-day storytelling.

items.question: Do you offer albums?
items.answer: We design museum-grade albums with archival paper, gilded edges and bespoke cover materials.

items.question: Are you fluent in English?
items.answer: Yes, we guide international couples through every step in English and provide bilingual questionnaires.

items.question: Do you provide vendor recommendations?
items.answer: We collaborate with local planners, florists and stylists to curate a seamless destination experience.

items.question: Where do family sessions take place?
items.answer: Choose between our natural-light studio, alpine meadows or your favorite family hideaway.

items.question: How do you keep children engaged?
items.answer: We schedule sessions around nap times, bring sensory toys and play music tailored to your kids.

items.question: Do you photograph newborns at home?
items.answer: Yes, we set up a mobile newborn studio with heaters, wraps and soothing white noise.

items.question: Can we include pets?
items.answer: Pets are always welcome; we allocate buffer time and treats to capture their personalities.

items.question: When will we receive the gallery?
items.answer: Preview highlights arrive within five days and the full gallery within three weeks.

items.question: Do you offer gift certificates?
items.answer: Elegant gift boxes with handcrafted vouchers are available for baby showers and anniversaries.

items.question: What styling support is available?
items.answer: A pre-session consultation covers wardrobe planning, posing guidance and personal branding goals.

items.question: Do you provide professional makeup?
items.answer: We work with top MUAs who specialize in HD camera-ready looks for any gender.

items.question: Can you shoot editorial fashion projects?
items.answer: Yes, our team crafts mood boards, sources stylists and manages production timelines.

items.question: How soon can we get retouched portraits?
items.answer: Standard turnaround is five business days with 48-hour rush delivery available.

items.question: Is there a location scouting service?
items.answer: We scout cinematic backdrops in Ljubljana, Bled, Trieste and Vienna to fit your vision.

items.question: What is required to secure a date?
items.answer: A signed agreement and 30% retainer lock in your coverage; the balance is due after delivery.

items.question: Do you accept credit cards?
items.answer: We accept bank transfers, major credit cards and wire transfers for international couples.

items.question: Are travel fees included?
items.answer: Travel within Slovenia is included; bespoke quotes apply for cross-border events.

items.question: Can we design a bespoke collection?
items.answer: Yes, we create immersive itineraries that combine welcome parties, elopements and post-wedding brunch coverage.

items.question: Do you offer payment plans?
items.answer: Split payments can be arranged in up to four installments for larger celebrations.

items.question: What gear do you use?
items.answer: We rely on dual-slot mirrorless cameras, prime lenses and redundant audio recorders.

items.question: How do you back up our images?
items.answer: Images are duplicated onsite, stored in the cloud and archived on encrypted drives.

items.question: Do you deliver a PWA gallery?
items.answer: Yes, your gallery is installable on mobile devices, supports favorites and offline viewing.

items.question: Are you insured?
items.answer: We carry global liability insurance and adhere to GDPR compliance for data handling.
